traj.q: Fellowship of the Ring cast Academy Award nominations

traj.txt:
Based on the provided documents and general knowledge regarding the cast of *The Lord of the Rings* film trilogy:

The actors who played characters in the **Fellowship of the Ring** (the nine members: Frodo, Sam, Merry, Pippin, Aragorn, Legolas, Gimli, Boromir, Gandalf) and have received an **Academy Award (Oscar) nomination** are:

1.  **Ian McKellen** (Gandalf): Nominated for **Best Supporting Actor** for *The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring* (2001). He also received a previous nomination for *Gods and Monsters*.
2.  **Viggo Mortensen** (Aragorn): While not nominated for his role in *The Lord of the Rings*, he has been nominated for Academy Awards for other films later in his career (*Eastern Promises* and *Captain Fantastic*).
3.  **Sean Bean** (Boromir): Has never been nominated for an Academy Award.
4.  **Elijah Wood** (Frodo Baggins): Has never been nominated for an Academy Award.
5.  **Sean Astin** (Samwise Gamgee): Has never been nominated for an Academy Award individually (though part of ensemble wins/nominations).
6.  **Dominic Monaghan** (Meriadoc Brandybuck): Has never been nominated for an Academy Award.
7.  **Billy Boyd** (Peregrin Took): Has never been nominated for an Academy Award.
8.  **Orlando Bloom** (Legolas): Has never been nominated for an Academy Award.
9.  **John Rhys-Davies** (Gimli): Has never been nominated for an Academy Award as an actor (he was nominated for a Primetime Emmy).

*Note: Ian Holm played Bilbo Baggins, who was a member of the Fellowship at its inception but left before the journey to Mordor began. If Bilbo is considered part of the "Fellowship" cast list in this context, Ian Holm would also be included as he was nominated for Best Supporting Actor for *Chariots of Fire*. However, strictly speaking regarding the nine members who undertook the quest together:*

The primary actors from the core Fellowship group with Oscar nominations are **Ian McKellen** and **Viggo Mortensen**.

Exact Answer: Ian McKellen and Viggo Mortensen

Main article: [macOS Ventura](/wiki/MacOS_Ventura "MacOS Ventura") [macOS Ventura](/wiki/MacOS_Ventura "MacOS Ventura") was announced during the WWDC keynote speech on June 6, 2022[[233]](#cite_note-238) and released on October 24, 2022.[[234]](#cite_note-239) It came with the redesigned System Preferences (named System Settings) to a more [iOS](/wiki/IOS "IOS")-like design, and the new [Freeform](/wiki/Freeform_(Apple) "Freeform (Apple)"), [Weather](/wiki/Weather_(Apple) "Weather (Apple)") and [Clock](/wiki/Clock_(Apple) "Clock (Apple)") apps that run natively on Mac. Users can use an iPhone as a webcam for video conferencing with Continuity Camera. Siri's appearance was changed to look more like the versions on [iOS 14](/wiki/IOS_14 "IOS 14") and [iPadOS 14](/wiki/IPadOS_14 "IPadOS 14"). [Mail](/wiki/Apple_Mail "Apple Mail") introduced schedule send and undo send for emails, and [Message](/wiki/IMessage "IMessage") also got the ability to undo send and edit messages. Stage Manager was introduced as a new way to organize all open windows in a desktop. [Maps](/wiki/Apple_Maps "Apple Maps") gained the feature for multiple-stop routes, [Metal 3](/wiki/Metal_(API) "Metal (API)") was added with support for spatial and temporal image upscaling, Lockdown Mode was added to reduce the risk of a cyberattack, and the ability to play ambient background sounds was added as an accessibility feature in System Settings.
